meaning.en: Of analysis or writing: penetrating and incisive.
meaning.zh: 形容分析透彻，切中要害。

examples.zh: 他的评论鞭辟入里，一针见血。
examples.en: His commentary is incisive and hits the mark.

examples.zh: 这篇文章对问题的分析鞭辟入里。
examples.en: The article's analysis of the problem is penetrating.

examples.zh: 老师讲得鞭辟入里，同学们茅塞顿开。
examples.en: The teacher's explanation cut to the heart of it, and the students suddenly understood.

usage.en: Predicate or complement 分析得鞭辟入里.

meaning.en: Thriving and prosperous.
meaning.zh: 事业或经济蓬勃发展，兴盛。

examples.zh: 祝愿祖国繁荣兴旺。
examples.en: May the motherland flourish and prosper.

examples.zh: 改革开放后，这座城市繁荣兴旺。
examples.en: After reform and opening up, the city thrived.

examples.zh: 商业街一派繁荣兴旺的景象。
examples.en: The shopping street was a thriving scene.

meaning.en: To wear hemp mourning clothes, as a family member of the dead.
meaning.zh: 穿着麻布丧服，戴着孝帽，为死者服丧。

examples.zh: 孙子们披麻戴孝，跪在灵前。
examples.en: The grandchildren knelt before the coffin in mourning dress.

examples.zh: 按老规矩，儿女要披麻戴孝三天。
examples.en: By old custom the children wear mourning dress for three days.

examples.zh: 他披麻戴孝，为父亲送葬。
examples.en: Dressed in mourning, he accompanied his father's coffin.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，指传统丧葬礼俗。

meaning.en: Intelligence and wisdom; being clever and wise.
meaning.zh: 聪明、有智慧。

examples.zh: 中国人民的聪明智慧创造了灿烂的文化。
examples.en: The intelligence and wisdom of the Chinese people created a splendid culture.

examples.zh: 这孩子聪明智慧，一教就会。
examples.en: The child is bright and wise and learns the moment he's taught.

examples.zh: 团队的聪明智慧是成功的关键。
examples.en: The team's collective wisdom is the key to success.

usage.en: Noun or adjective; broad, formal praise.
usage.zh: 作名词或形容词，多为泛泛赞语。

meaning.en: The dignity of the teacher's way; teachers deserve respect.
meaning.zh: 老师的地位、教导应受尊重。

examples.zh: 传统教育强调师道尊严。
examples.en: Traditional education stresses respect for teachers.

examples.zh: 他认为师道尊严不可侵犯。
examples.en: He holds that the teacher's dignity must not be violated.

examples.zh: 师道尊严不是靠打骂，而是靠学识和品德。
examples.en: The teacher's dignity comes from learning and character, not from scolding.

story.en: Liji: 'Only when the teacher is respected will the way be honoured' (凡学之道，严师为难；师严然后道尊).
story.zh: 《礼记·学记》：“凡学之道，严师为难。师严然后道尊，道尊然后民知敬学。”

usage.en: Object or subject; sometimes criticised as old-fashioned.
usage.zh: 作主语、宾语，有时被批评为陈旧。

meaning.en: To make a big issue of something, exploiting a small matter.
meaning.zh: 借一件事大加渲染或发挥，多含贬义。

equivalents: make a mountain out of a molehill

examples.zh: 媒体对他的一句话大做文章。
examples.en: The media made a big fuss over one remark of his.

examples.zh: 没必要在小事上大做文章。
examples.en: There's no need to make a big deal of small matters.

examples.zh: 商家在包装上大做文章，内容却一般。
examples.en: Merchants make a show of packaging while the contents are mediocre.

meaning.en: An ordinary, unremarkable person (usually in the negative: 'no ordinary person').
meaning.zh: 平常、普通的人，常用否定形式。

examples.zh: 别小看他，他可不是等闲之辈。
examples.en: Don't underestimate him; he's no ordinary person.

examples.zh: 能拿到这个奖的，绝非等闲之辈。
examples.en: Whoever won this prize is certainly no run-of-the-mill person.

examples.zh: 对手也不是等闲之辈。
examples.en: The opponent is no pushover either.

usage.zh: 多用于“非/不是等闲之辈”。

meaning.en: Rare and precious treasures.
meaning.zh: 稀有珍贵的东西。

examples.zh: 博物馆里陈列着许多奇珍异宝。
examples.en: The museum displays many rare treasures.

examples.zh: 皇宫里堆满了奇珍异宝。
examples.en: The palace was stacked with precious treasures.

examples.zh: 他走遍世界，搜集奇珍异宝。
examples.en: He travelled the world collecting rarities.

meaning.en: Greed is as hard to fill as a deep gully.
meaning.zh: 贪欲像深沟一样难以填满。

examples.zh: 他欲壑难填，拿了还想要。
examples.en: He's insatiable: taking more and still wanting more.

examples.zh: 人心不足，欲壑难填。
examples.en: Human greed is never satisfied.

examples.zh: 面对欲壑难填的对手，谈判几乎无法进行。
examples.en: Facing an insatiable opponent, negotiation was nearly impossible.

pinyin: yuǎn shuǐ jiě bù liǎo jìn kě
literal: distant · water · cannot · quench · near · thirst
natural: far water won't quench thirst now

meaning.en: Help that is far away cannot meet an urgent need.
meaning.zh: 远处的水救不了眼前的渴，比喻缓慢的办法解决不了急迫的问题。

equivalents: help that is too far off to be of use

examples.zh: 等外地支援赶到就晚了，远水解不了近渴。
examples.en: By the time outside help comes it's too late: far water can't quench near thirst.

examples.zh: 你给我寄钱，远水解不了近渴，我今天就要交房租。
examples.en: Sending me money won't help; I have to pay rent today.

examples.zh: 远水解不了近渴，还是先找附近的人帮忙。
examples.en: Distant help won't meet the urgent need, so ask someone nearby first.

usage.en: Proverb; also 远水救不了近火.
usage.zh: 谚语；也说“远水救不了近火”。

pinyin: shàng liáng bù zhèng xià liáng wāi
literal: upper · beam · not · straight · lower · beam · crooked
natural: when the top is crooked, so is the bottom

meaning.en: If those above behave badly, those below will follow.
meaning.zh: 上面的人行为不正，下面的人也跟着学坏。

equivalents: a fish rots from the head
like father, like son (in bad ways)

examples.zh: 领导带头请客送礼，上梁不正下梁歪。
examples.en: The leader led in giving gifts; when the beam above is crooked, those below follow.

examples.zh: 父母总打牌，孩子也不爱学习，真是上梁不正下梁歪。
examples.en: The parents always play cards and the child dislikes studying: the upper beam is crooked.

examples.zh: 上梁不正下梁歪，管理者要以身作则。
examples.en: Those above set the example, so managers must lead by example.

meaning.en: To commit suicide (euphemistic).
meaning.zh: 自杀（委婉说法）。

examples.zh: 大家怕他想不开，会自寻短见。
examples.en: Everyone feared he might take his own life.

examples.zh: 别为这点事自寻短见，生命最宝贵。
examples.en: Don't take your life for this; life is most precious.

examples.zh: 遇到困难，千万不要自寻短见。
examples.en: Whatever the difficulty, never do anything desperate.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，委婉语，使用需谨慎。

meaning.en: To praise and hold in the highest regard.
meaning.zh: 对人或事物极其推重、崇敬。

examples.zh: 评论家对这部作品推崇备至。
examples.en: Critics hold the work in the highest esteem.

examples.zh: 他对这位老师推崇备至。
examples.en: He holds this teacher in the highest regard.

examples.zh: 业内人士对其技术推崇备至。
examples.en: Industry insiders praise its technology to the skies.

meaning.en: A blessing for wealth: may money and treasures come in.
meaning.zh: 祝愿财源兴旺，多得财宝。

examples.zh: 新年到了，祝您招财进宝！
examples.en: Happy New Year, may wealth roll in for you!

examples.zh: 店门口贴着“招财进宝”四个大字。
examples.en: The four characters 'zhāo cái jìn bǎo' were posted at the shop door.

examples.zh: 这只招财进宝的小猫摆件很受欢迎。
examples.en: This 'welcome wealth' cat figurine is very popular.

usage.zh: 用作祝福语或装饰，春节常见。

natural: a mix of feint and fact

meaning.en: A mix of what is false and what is true, to confuse the other side.
meaning.zh: 真假交错，使人难辨。

equivalents: a mix of bluff and truth

examples.zh: 谈判中他虚虚实实，让对手摸不透底牌。
examples.en: In negotiations he mixed bluff with truth, so rivals couldn't read his hand.

examples.zh: 这部电影虚虚实实，真假难辨。
examples.en: The film blends fact and fiction so you can't tell them apart.

examples.zh: 兵法讲究虚虚实实，以假乱真。
examples.en: The art of war values feint and fact, with fakes passing for real.

meaning.en: To do a lot of harm to others.
meaning.zh: 对别人危害很大。

examples.zh: 这种假药害人不浅。
examples.en: This fake medicine does great harm.

examples.zh: 谣言害人不浅，千万别传。
examples.en: Rumours do real harm; don't spread them.

examples.zh: 沉迷游戏害人不浅。
examples.en: Game addiction does a lot of damage.

meaning.en: Wise and full of schemes; resourceful.
meaning.zh: 富有智慧，善于谋划。

examples.zh: 诸葛亮足智多谋，是蜀汉的丞相。
examples.en: Zhuge Liang was resourceful and shrewd, the chancellor of Shu Han.

examples.zh: 他是个足智多谋的谈判专家。
examples.en: He's a resourceful negotiator.

examples.zh: 这位足智多谋的队长带领大家脱险。
examples.en: The resourceful captain led everyone out of danger.

synonyms: 运筹帷幄之中，决胜千里之外

meaning.en: Broad daylight; also something clear and above-board.
meaning.zh: 大白天；也比喻清白、光明。

examples.zh: 青天白日，竟有人当街行窃。
examples.en: In broad daylight someone picked pockets in the street.

examples.zh: 青天白日的，你怕什么？
examples.en: It's broad daylight, so what are you afraid of?

examples.zh: 他一生清清白白，如青天白日。
examples.en: He lived an honest life, clear as day.

natural: ask all kinds of caring questions

meaning.en: To ask all sorts of friendly questions out of concern.
meaning.zh: 关切地向人问这问那。

examples.zh: 奶奶见孙子回来，问长问短。
examples.en: Grandma saw her grandson return and asked about everything.

examples.zh: 邻居们围着她问长问短。
examples.en: The neighbours gathered round, asking her all sorts of questions.

examples.zh: 他对新同事问长问短，很热心。
examples.en: He was warm, asking his new colleague lots of questions.

meaning.en: Everyone in the nation is a soldier; total mobilisation for defence.
meaning.zh: 全国人民都成为战士，全民参与国防。

examples.zh: 战争时期，全民皆兵，共同保卫国土。
examples.en: In wartime the whole nation took up arms to defend the land.

examples.zh: 这个国家实行全民皆兵制度。
examples.en: The country has a system of universal military service.

examples.zh: 他们提倡全民皆兵，加强国防教育。
examples.en: They advocate universal defence and stronger defence education.

meaning.en: To avoid being noticed by others.
meaning.zh: 躲避别人的注意，不让人看见听见。

examples.zh: 他们为避人耳目，半夜才见面。
examples.en: To avoid prying eyes, they met only at midnight.

examples.zh: 他戴着帽子，避人耳目地走出酒店。
examples.en: Wearing a hat, he left the hotel without being noticed.

examples.zh: 会议选在偏僻的地方，以避人耳目。
examples.en: The meeting was held in a remote spot to avoid attention.

usage.en: Predicate or purpose clause; not the same as 掩人耳目 (to deceive others).
usage.zh: 作谓语；与“掩人耳目”（蒙蔽别人）不同。
